entities.summary: Park Sung-jin (b. 1993-01-16, Busan) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Busan and South Korea. Known in the fields of south korea, composers & musicians, asia.
